arxiv-2108-13168.title: Hyperbolic Basis Functions for Time-Transient Analysis of Eddy Currents in Conductive and Magnetic Thin Sheets
arxiv-2108-13168.creator: Bruno de Sousa Alves 1 , Ruth V. Sabariego 2 , Marc Laforest 1 , and Frédéric Sirois 1
arxiv-2108-13168.description: Abstract This paper presents a new time-domain finite-element approach for modelling thin sheets with hyperbolic basis functions derived from the well-known steady-state solution of the linear flux diffusion equation. The combination of solutions at different operating frequencies permits the representation of the time-evolution of field quantities in the magnetic field formulation.

arxiv-2112-08864.title: Matrix factorizations of generic polynomials
arxiv-2112-08864.creator: Daniel Erman
arxiv-2112-08864.description: Abstract . We prove that the Buchweitz-Greuel-Schreyer Conjecture on the minimal rank of a matrix factorization holds for a generic polynomial of given degree and strength. The proof introduces a notion of the secondary strength of a polynomial, and uses a variant of the ultraproduct technique of Erman, Sam, and Snowden. 1.

arxiv-2211-03825.title: A generalized theory of Brownian particle diffusion in shear flows
arxiv-2211-03825.creator: Nan Wang, Yuval Dagan
arxiv-2211-03825.description: Abstract This study presents a generalized theory for the diffusion of Brownian particles in shear flows. By solving the Langevin equations using stochastic instead of classical calculus, we propose a new mathematical formulation that resolves the particle MSD at all time scales for any two-dimensional parallel shear flow described by a polynomial velocity profile.

arxiv-2212-12529.title: Hybridization driving distortions and multiferroicity in rare-earth nickelates
arxiv-2212-12529.creator: Luca Binci, Michele Kotiuga, Iurii Timrov, Nicola Marzari
arxiv-2212-12529.description: Abstract For decades transition-metal oxides have generated a huge interest due to the multitude of physical phenomena they exhibit. In this class of materials, the rare-earth nickelates, R R NiO 3 , stand out for their rich phase diagram stemming from complex couplings between the lattice, electronic and magnetic degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2303-01812.title: Unified Keyword Spotting and Audio Tagging on Mobile Devices with Transformers
arxiv-2303-01812.creator: Heinrich Dinkel, Yongqing Wang, Zhiyong Yan, Junbo Zhang, Yujun Wang
arxiv-2303-01812.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Heinrich Dinkel, Yongqing Wang, Zhiyong Yan, Junbo Zhang, Yujun Wang. Keyword spotting (KWS) is a core human-machine-interaction front-end task for most modern intelligent assistants. Recently, a unified (UniKW-AT) framework has been proposed that adds additional capabilities in the form of audio tagging (AT) to a KWS model. However, previous work did not consider the real-world deployment of a UniKW-AT model, where factors such as model size and inference speed are more important than performance alone.

arxiv-2312-10188.title: WordScape: a Pipeline to extract multilingual, visually rich Documents with Layout Annotations from Web Crawl Data
arxiv-2312-10188.creator: Maurice WeberETH Zurich, Carlo SiebenschuhUniversity of Chicago, Rory M. ButlerUniversity of ChicagoAnton AlexandrovETH Zurich,INSAIT, Sofia UniversityValdemar R. ThannerETH ZurichGeorgios TsolakisETH ZurichHaris JabbarTU darmstadtIan FosterArgonne National Laboratory,University of ChicagoBo LiUIUCR
arxiv-2312-10188.description: Abstract We introduce WordScape, a novel pipeline for the creation of cross-disciplinary, multilingual corpora comprising millions of pages with annotations for document layout detection. Relating visual and textual items on document pages has gained further significance with the advent of multimodal models. Various approaches proved effective for visual question answering or layout segmentation.

arxiv-2408-11336.title: FATE: Focal-modulated Attention Encoder for Multivariate Time-series Forecasting
arxiv-2408-11336.creator: Tajamul Ashraf, Janibul Bashir
arxiv-2408-11336.description: Abstract Accurate multivariate time-series forecasting is crucial for understanding and mitigating the effects of climate change, as reliable long-horizon predictions support effective monitoring and informed decision-making. Existing neural approaches, ranging from CNNs and RNNs to attention-based Transformers, have achieved notable progress.

arxiv-2602-19628.title: Towards Understanding Views on Combining Videos and Gamification in Software Engineering Training Conference: 2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering; April 12–18, 2026; Rio de Janeiro, Brazil 2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE-Compa
arxiv-2602-19628.creator: Pasan Peiris, Matthias Galster, Antonija Mitrovic, Sanna Malinen, Raul Vincent Lumapas, Jay Holland
arxiv-2602-19628.description: Abstract . Watching training videos passively leads to superficial learning. Adding gamification can increase engagement. We study how software engineering students and industry practitioners view gamifying video-based training. We conducted a survey with students and professionals. Students and professionals share similar perceptions toward video-based training in general and support combining gamification and video-based training.

pmc-10646998.title: The role of quantitative markers in surgical prognostication after stereoelectroencephalography
pmc-10646998.creator: Julia Makhalova, Tanguy Madec, Samuel Medina Villalon, Aude Jegou, Stanislas Lagarde, Romain Carron, Didier Scavarda, Elodie Garnier, Christian G Bénar, Fabrice Bartolomei
pmc-10646998.description: ObjectiveStereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) is the reference method in the presurgical exploration of drug‐resistant focal epilepsy. However, prognosticating surgery on an individual level is difficult. A quantified estimation of the most epileptogenic regions by searching for relevant biomarkers can be proposed for this purpose.

pmc-10651565.title: A rare case of localized peliosis hepatis during adjuvant chemotherapy including oxaliplatin mimicking a liver metastasis of colon cancer
pmc-10651565.creator: Akira Dejima, Yasuji Seyama, Daisuke Nakano, Misato Takao, Soichiro Natsume, Mikiya Takao, Sakiko Nakamori, Tatsuya Kanai, Shinichiro Horiguchi, Kazushige Kawai
pmc-10651565.description: BackgroundOxaliplatin-based regimens are commonly used as adjuvant chemotherapy following surgery for colorectal cancer. Adverse events associated with oxaliplatin include blue liver, which is caused by sinusoidal dilation and diffuse peliosis hepatis. We report herein a case of localized peliosis hepatis closely resembling a metastatic liver tumor.

pmc-11508927.title: Chemically Pretreated Densification of Juniper Wood for Potential Use in Osteosynthesis Bone Implants
pmc-11508927.creator: Laura Andze, Vadims Nefjodovs, Martins Andzs, Marite Skute, Juris Zoldners, Martins Kapickis, Arita Dubnika, Janis Locs, Janis Vetra
pmc-11508927.description: The aim of the study was to perform treatment of juniper wood to obtain wood material with a density and mechanical properties comparable to bone, thus producing a potential material for use in osteosynthesis bone implants. In the first step, partial delignification of wood sample was obtained by Kraft cooking.

pmc-11650035.creator: EFSA Panel on Food Enzymes (FEZ), Holger Zorn, José Manuel Barat Baviera, Claudia Bolognesi, Francesco Catania, Gabriele Gadermaier, Ralf Greiner, Baltasar Mayo, Alicja Mortensen, Yrjö Henrik Roos, Marize L M Solano, Monika Sramkova, Henk Van Loveren, Laurence Vernis, Andrew Chesson, Lieve Herman, N
pmc-11650035.description: The food enzyme fructan β‐fructosidase (β‐d‐fructan fructohydrolase; EC 3.2.1.80) is produced with the genetically modified Trichoderma reesei strain AR‐577 by AB Enzymes GmbH. The genetic modifications do not give rise to safety concerns. The food enzyme is free from viable cells of the production organism and its DNA.

pmc-12518594.creator: Andrea Bille, Camilla Cavalli, George Papaxoinis, Emma McLean, Daisuke Nonaka
pmc-12518594.description: BackgroundWorld Health Organization (WHO) classification defines subdivision of type B group (B1, B2, and B3) based on proportion of neoplastic epithelial cells and non-neoplastic lymphocytes, and a number of studies have demonstrated correlation between the subtype and prognosis, with type B3 being unfavorable.

pmc-12607238.title: Prolonged and Refractory Hypophosphataemia Following Intravenous Ferric Carboxymaltose Administration Delaying Hospital Discharge: A Case Report
pmc-12607238.creator: Zohaib Sajid
pmc-12607238.description: Hypophosphataemia is an under-recognised complication of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose (Ferinject). While often transient and asymptomatic, in some cases, it may be severe and prolonged. We describe a man in his 40s with iron deficiency anaemia who received two 1,000 mg doses of ferric carboxymaltose within one week.

pmc-12658502.title: Resonant breathing in hospitalised psychiatric patients with persistent somatic symptoms: a randomised controlled trial
pmc-12658502.creator: Markus Canazei, Katharina Hüfner, Barbara Sperner-Unterweger, Astrid Lampe, Johannes Weninger, Siegmund Staggl, Verena Dresen, Elisabeth Weiss
pmc-12658502.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPersistent somatic symptoms are a common feature in many psychiatric disorders. Moderate-to-severe cases often necessitate treatment in specialised inpatient psychiatric settings.AimsThis study evaluated the efficacy, safety and acceptability of resonant breathing (personalised slow breathing to maximise heart rate variability (HRV)) as adjunctive treatment for hospitalised patients with psychiatric disorders presenting with persistent somatic symptoms on admission, when patients typically present with high symptom severity.MethodsThis multicentre, randomised, placebo-controlled cross-over study included 78 patients diagnosed with somatic symptom disorder or affective disorders with persistent

pmc-12820253.title: Pan-cancer analysis of DTX3L as a potential prognostic and immunological biomarker
pmc-12820253.creator: Yunfeng Zhang, Jingyi Mu, Yue Lu, Jiayu Jing, Jianmei Huang, Zhenglong Guo, Wenke Yang, Guiyu Lou, Yue Wang
pmc-12820253.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). DTX3L plays pivotal roles in diverse biological processes, yet its multifaceted functions and the molecular mechanisms driving tumorigenesis and cancer progression remain incompletely defined. Here, we systematically investigated DTX3L’s expression profiles, prognostic value, and potential regulatory mechanisms across pan-cancers. By integrating data from multiple databases, we analyzed the expression levels of DTX3L and its correlations with clinicopathological features, prognosis, and immune infiltration. Leveraging the STRING database, we identified DTX3L-associated genes and performed functional enrichment analysis.

pmc-12961060.title: A Qualitative Analysis of Letters to Successors to Evaluate Medical Students’ Experience of a Mandatory Research Project
pmc-12961060.creator: Declan Rosborough, Rajneesh Kaur, Joanne Hart
pmc-12961060.description: BackgroundResearch capability is a key graduate outcome in medical education, yet student experiences of mandatory research components remain underexplored. This study investigated medical students’ experiences of a compulsory research project within an Australian medical degree program, identifying enablers, barriers, and perceived outcomes.

pmc-13000683.title: Fat Mass Influences Femur Bone Strength and Geometry Parameters, but Not Bone Mineral Density, in Autoimmune Diabetes: A Pilot Study
pmc-13000683.creator: Renata Risi, Rocco Amendolara, Vahideh Abedi, Francesco De Vita, Federica Barbaro, Angela Balena, Mikiko Watanabe, Daniela Luverà, Angelo Lauria Pantano, Luca D'Onofrio, Raffaella Buzzetti, Ernesto Maddaloni, AD_OWOB study group
pmc-13000683.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAutoimmune diabetes (AD) increases fracture risk. Overweight worsens bone health despite increasing bone mineral density (BMD). This study examines how adiposity influences BMD and Dual X‐Ray Absorptiometry (DXA)‐derived parameters of bone geometry and strength in AD.MethodsDXA scan was used to assess body mass composition, BMD, trabecular bone score (TBS), and hip structural analysis (HSA)‐derived parameters at narrow neck (NN), intertrochanteric (IT) and femur shaft (FS) in 52 normal weight adults with AD and 51 with AD and overweight.

pmc-13286791.title: Italian healthcare professionals' real-world experience with immunization in children of non-European origin: the Vax4globe survey
pmc-13286791.creator: Viviana Moschese, Simona Graziani, Antonietta Spadea, Maurizia D’Amore, Raffaella Mosco, Sara Ciampini, Nicola Di Giorgio, Susanna Arcano, Simona Ceccarelli, Marco Chianca, Simona Piccinini, Antonella Polito, Marta Porcari, Pamela Puliafito, Romina Silenzi, Elisabetta Del Duca, Alfonso Piciocchi, Cl
pmc-13286791.description: IntroductionNowadays vaccine hesitancy represents a significant current global health threat, causing reduced vaccine coverage with relevant effects on vulnerable populations. This study explores Italian healthcare professionals' (HCPs) experience with immunization of non-European (non-EU) origin children to implement targeted strategies for higher vaccine coverage and a “vulnerables-friendly care”.

pmc-13289585.title: Substrate selectivity of the human RNA m5C methyltransferase NSUN2
pmc-13289585.creator: Jacob Canepa, Victor M Ruiz-Arroyo, Netanya S Schlamowitz, Yunsun Nam
pmc-13289585.description: Specific deposition of RNA modifications is important for regulating gene expression1,2. 5-Methylcytosine (m5C) is a common epitranscriptomic modification, and NSUN2 is a key enzyme responsible for m5C methylation of various types of RNA. Dysregulation of NSUN2 is associated with numerous diseases, including cancers and neurological disorders3.

pmc-13654129.title: Computed tomography-guided percutaneous puncture injection of methylene blue mixed with autologous blood for preoperative localization of pulmonary nodules: analysis of 407 cases
pmc-13654129.creator: Kang He, Bao-Rui Ren, Run-Long Sui, Cheng Zhao, Xu-Long Yuan, Zhi-Gang Sun
pmc-13654129.description: BackgroundComputed tomography (CT)-guided preoperative localization using methylene blue mixed with autologous blood is a commonly used technique for pulmonary nodules. However, its safety profile and risk factors for complications remain to be fully elucidated. This study aimed to evaluate the safety and complication risk of this technique and to explore the risk factors associated with the occurrence of complications.

uslaw-usc-t36-s190112.title: 36 U.S.C. § 190112 — Distribution of assets on dissolution or final liquidation
uslaw-usc-t36-s190112.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s190112.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1901 (Reserve Officers Association Of The United States). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. On dissolution or final liquidation of the corporation, any assets remaining after the discharge of all liabilities shall be divided equally among the then active officers and members.
